tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a. All ASRTU RC Sources with minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 4 crores for preceding continuous three years out of four years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 are eligible to participate, duly supported by the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing/Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years and Certificate of verification of turnover issued by the CA in support of turnover declared. b. Manufacturers with minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 4 crores for preceding continuous three years out of four years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 are eligible to participate, duly supported by the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing/Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years and Certificate of verification of turnover issued by the CA in support of turnover declared. The Bidder should submit the samples of a. 1mx20mx1.5mm thickness Self Adhesive Polymer Modified Bituminous Composite Membrane with Aluminum Foil at the Top and demonstrate the method of application in one of the buses of the Corporation on free of cost basis b.High Elasticity Tape for bus roof top of size 6 inch width - 1 Roll length - as per standard size for bus roof top. The Commercial Offer of the bidders whose sample is approved by Mechanical Engineering Department of BMTC should only be opened subject to fulfillment of pre-qualification criteria
